# TableHead

Header section of table

## Overview

- **Category**: data-display
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: TableHead

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { TableHead } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<TableHead>
  <TableRow>
    <TableCell>Header 1</TableCell>
    <TableCell>Header 2</TableCell>
  </TableRow>
</TableHead>
```

## Examples

```tsx
<TableHead>
  <TableRow>
    <TableCell>Header 1</TableCell>
    <TableCell>Header 2</TableCell>
  </TableRow>

```

## MUI Reference

This component is based on Material-UI's TableHead.

For additional props and detailed API documentation, refer to:
